g.text: Movie search and recommendation: application-level validation of AEIC mechanism
Deterministic retrieval grounds candidates; multi-agent reports are measured and controlled before evidence-aware ranking.
Validation endpoints: constraint satisfaction · invalid-candidate rate · evidence support · NDCG@K · calls/tokens · P95 latency · degradation success
